guarantees.claim: If st equals StIdle then stL = StIdleL; if st equals StMsgFeed then stL = StMsgFeedL; if st equals StProcessing then stL = StProcessingL; if st equals StAbsorbed then stL = StAbsorbedL; if st equals StSqueezing then stL = StSqueezingL; for any other value (including X, Z, or unmapped encoding) stL = StErrorL.

uncertain_points.claim: Downstream logic that receives stL must correctly interpret StErrorL as an error state; otherwise an invalid st encoding will silently map to a non-error behavior or continue operation.
uncertain_points.cond: When st takes an invalid value (e.g., due to a glitch, X, or unlisted encoding), stL becomes StErrorL.
uncertain_points.risk: If downstream logic does not treat StErrorL as a hard error, the system may operate with corrupted control state or produce incorrect outputs.
